scope: Exactly the legacy Phase7 candidate concept-state edges expanded by an explicit pre-existing state-to-Hallmark name mapping; no new concept-program associations added.

state_to_program_provenance.method: AST literal extraction of STATES/HALLMARK_NAMES followed by the exact already-implemented positional zip; no fuzzy matching, semantic matching, keyword matching, or outcome selection.

matrix_order_rule: Rows are frozen Phase6A concept order; columns are the current R0 Hallmark50 registry order. Consumers must join by exact names and reject missing/duplicate columns, never assume a different GMT row order.

mask_semantics.one_in_allowed_mask: Allowed candidate association, not verified presence, directional activation, confidence probability, causal edge or supervised label.
mask_semantics.zero_in_allowed_mask: Unknown evidence status, not evidence of absence or a negative biological association.
mask_semantics.unknown_weighting: Unknown entries must remain available to the separately locked low-rank content interaction as required by the main protocol; the zero marker must not be interpreted as an obligatory hard zero interaction weight.
mask_semantics.CNA: Gain and loss retain distinct channels and measured masks. Program-named CNA dosage must not be equated with RNA activation; the inheritance does not certify CNA-specific morphology relationships.
mask_semantics.grouping: No new 8-group mapping is inferred here. Aggregate these 32 concept rows only after the frozen text-only group assignment is locked; retain this fine-grained provenance.

primary_source_recheck.title: The consensus molecular subtypes of colorectal cancer
primary_source_recheck.supports: CMS4 is described by mesenchymal/stromal features, TGF-beta activity and angiogenesis; CMS1 by immune activation.
primary_source_recheck.does_not_establish: A specific patient has visible desmoplasia, collagen abundance, vascular counts, or a named lymphocyte arrangement; no one-to-one Hallmark-morphology label is established.

primary_source_recheck.title: Decoupling epithelial-mesenchymal transitions from stromal profiles by integrative expression analysis
primary_source_recheck.supports: Single-cell and simulated bulk analyses demonstrate that mesenchymal signature signal can be dominated by fibroblasts; cancer-cell partial EMT is context dependent.
primary_source_recheck.does_not_establish: Bulk EMT score uniquely measures tumor-cell EMT, proves tumor budding, or determines a patient-specific causal source.

primary_source_recheck.title: Expression profiling of budding cells in colorectal cancer reveals an EMT-like phenotype and molecular subtype switching
primary_source_recheck.access: PRIMARY_SEARCH_INDEXED_ABSTRACT_AND_FULL_TEXT_EXTRACT_READ; direct Nature redirected, direct PMC browser challenge and PubMed page incomplete
primary_source_recheck.supports: Laser-microdissected colorectal budding regions showed EMT-like expression and a shift toward a mesenchymal subtype compared with matched tumor bulk.
primary_source_recheck.does_not_establish: An unlocalized bulk Hallmark EMT score detects buds in these TCGA slides; RNA pathway activity and morphology are not equivalent.

gene_membership_version_caveat.mapping_level: program name and broad external candidate context only
gene_membership_version_caveat.meaning: R0 records all eight old same-named lists differing from the newer Hallmark50 members. This file does not claim old and new activity scores or measured gene supports are equivalent; actual current membership, coverage and masks require train-side data qualification.

background_regression_contract.rule: First freeze each own PhaseA representation. Fit training-only OOF Ridge clinical-background predictions in that same learned coordinate system; validation uses current-fit-train full background regressor.
background_regression_contract.shared_pretraining: B4/B5 may share exactly the same no-DSS PhaseA weights/fit budget; count that shared pretraining once and do not call it independent architecture training.
background_regression_contract.forbidden: Do not concatenate embeddings from independently trained inner-fold models as if their latent axes were aligned.

limitations: Only 12 of 32 concepts and 6 of 50 programs have inherited candidate edges; sparsity is reported, not repaired by invented links.
Some old low-confidence relations are indirect biological hypotheses, including necrosis/hypoxia and immune-subtype/lymphoid architecture; legacy confidence is preserved without upgrading certainty.
The primary papers do not validate the current TCGA named concept scores or provide ROI ground truth.
This config is outcome-blind but not proof that text or sparse biology will improve pairing or DSS.
